doc: The instance's building style — an OVERLAY on the structure realizer's built-in palette (client/lib/realize/structure.js), the 'style catalog seam' its comment anticipates. Slots are engine (wall/floor/trim/roof/glass), finishes are engine shader nodes named here (plaster/boards/painted; glass takes none); VALUES are style: color (decimal int; hex in each slot's doc), roughness, and glass's opacity. Applied by mutating the live shared materials, so a def edit restyles standing buildings on the defs-updated push. Absent slots keep the built-in default.
